steps.name: Clicking on seller choose field
Enter seller name
Selecting desired Seller
Clicking on Menu Tab seller
Clicking on Seller Packages Tab
Clicking on Flexi Packages Sub Tab
Clicking on Package Table Refresh Button
Entering Campaign Name In Search Campaign Field
Clicking on Book Now Button for a Flexi Package
Entering Booking Name
Clicking on Slot Duration Dropdown
Selecting Slot Duration Option
Entering Booking Note
Clicking on Booking Details Save Button
Validate booking details saved successfully message
Clicking on pop up close button
Click on the Line Item Header to expand Line Item section
Validate product Selection Status
Clicking Line Item save button
Validate product selection error popup is displayed
Clicking on pop up close button
Clicking on the Product Selection Card
Clicking on the product selection type dropdown
Choosing 'Select Product to include' option from dropdown
Clicking on Yes button if available
Click on the product Selection type dropdown
